data.title: Gas price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Muster Gas GmbH announces a price change for the "Muster Gas Komfort" gas tariff from 1 November 2026. The monthly advance payment rises from €96.00 to €109.00.
data.explanation: Your gas provider is raising its prices from 1 November 2026. The price per kWh goes up, while the base fee stays the same. Your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €96.00 to €109.00. You may cancel the contract without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect. Text form such as an e-mail is enough. You can decide whether to cancel or stay, and the app shows until when the special cancellation right applies. You could compare other tariffs before deciding.
